name: Millennia Credit Card

cashback.online: 5% on Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Swiggy, Uber

summary: Focused purely on cashback for online spenders, this card offers 5% flat cashback on online purchases with no reward points. Fuel benefits are modest, and it lacks lounge and dining perks. With a ₹999 fee, it’s best for online-heavy spenders who want simple and direct savings. Suitable for users earning above ₹3L annually

name: Regalia Gold Credit Card
insurance: Air accident cover and travel benefits
summary: A premium lifestyle and travel card offering strong reward earnings, airport lounge access, dining privileges, and travel benefits. It is designed for frequent travelers and high spenders who want a balance of rewards and premium perks.

name: MoneyBack+ Credit Card

cashback.online: 10X CashPoints on Amazon, Flipkart and Swiggy

summary: An entry-level rewards credit card focused on everyday spending. It provides accelerated rewards on popular online platforms and basic fuel benefits, making it suitable for first-time credit card users.

name: IndianOil HDFC Credit Card

cashback.fuel: Up to 5% value back at IndianOil outlets

fuel_benefits: Up to 5% savings on fuel spends
summary: Designed specifically for motorists, this card offers significant savings on fuel purchases at IndianOil outlets along with surcharge waivers. It is ideal for users with high monthly fuel expenses.

name: Swiggy HDFC Credit Card

cashback.online: 10% on Swiggy, 5% on selected online merchants

summary: Built for food delivery and online shopping enthusiasts, this card offers one of the highest cashback rates on Swiggy transactions along with attractive rewards on everyday online spending.

name: Tata Neu Plus Credit Card
summary: An affordable co-branded card for Tata ecosystem users. It rewards purchases across Tata brands including BigBasket, Croma, Air India and Tata CLiQ through NeuCoins.

name: Tata Neu Infinity Credit Card
summary: The premium version of Tata Neu Plus, offering higher NeuCoin earnings, lounge access, and enhanced travel and lifestyle benefits for users heavily invested in the Tata ecosystem.

name: Diners Club Privilege Credit Card
summary: A lifestyle-focused Diners Club card that combines good reward earnings, airport lounge access, and entertainment benefits. Suitable for professionals seeking travel and lifestyle perks.

name: Infinia Metal Edition
insurance: Comprehensive travel and air accident cover
summary: HDFC Bank's flagship super-premium credit card. It provides excellent reward rates, unlimited lounge access, luxury travel benefits, golf privileges, and comprehensive insurance coverage.

name: Diners Club Black Metal Edition
summary: A premium travel and lifestyle card offering strong reward rates, unlimited airport lounge access, golf benefits, travel insurance, and premium concierge services.
